verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Bugbot installs via GitHub and GitLab apps (and Bitbucket/Azure DevOps), runs automatically on every PR update, and posts findings as inline PR comments with fix suggestions; community reports corroborate it actively commenting on live PRs in production orgs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence/timing data confirming reviews appear 'within minutes' of PR creation, and independent screenshots of the native inline comment UI.
